judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.J.Res. 130, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Bureau of Land Management amendment that had ended new federal coal leasing in the Buffalo field office in Wyoming's Powder River Basin. It passed the House 214-212.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.J.Res. 130, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Bureau of Land Management amendment that had ended new federal coal leasing in the Buffalo field office in Wyoming's Powder River Basin. It passed the House 214-212.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.J.Res. 131, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Bureau of Land Management decision limiting the coastal plain oil and gas leasing program, opening more of the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge to drilling. It passed the House 217-209.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.J.Res. 131, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Bureau of Land Management decision limiting the coastal plain oil and gas leasing program, opening more of the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge to drilling. It passed the House 217-209.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to send S.J.Res. 80 to the President, using the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Bureau of Land Management's activity plan for the National Petroleum Reserve in Alaska and reopen parts of the 23-million-acre reserve to oil and gas leasing. It passed the House 216-209.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending S.J.Res. 80 to the President, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Bureau of Land Management's activity plan for the National Petroleum Reserve in Alaska and reopen parts of the 23-million-acre reserve to oil and gas leasing. It passed the House 216-209.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 5214, the District of Columbia Cash Bail Reform Act, which required pretrial detention for violent and dangerous crimes in DC and required cash bail for pretrial release in other public safety cases. It passed the House 237-179.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 5214, the District of Columbia Cash Bail Reform Act, which required pretrial detention for violent and dangerous crimes in DC and required cash bail for pretrial release in other public safety cases. It passed the House 237-179.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 1949, the Unlocking our Domestic LNG Potential Act, which repealed the Department of Energy approval requirement for natural gas imports and exports and gave federal energy regulators sole authority over LNG terminal applications. It passed the House 217-188.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 1949, the Unlocking our Domestic LNG Potential Act, which repealed the Department of Energy approval requirement for natural gas imports and exports and gave federal energy regulators sole authority over LNG terminal applications. It passed the House 217-188.
